content:
Texas A&M International University will open its campus to families Thursday, Oct. 29, for its annual Halloween Fest, a free, family-friendly evening running from 6 to 9 p.m. on the Senator Judith Zaffirini Student Success Center Green, according to TAMIU.

The event, hosted by the Campus Activities Board with the university's Office of Student Orientation, Leadership, and Engagement, will feature food, games, a costume contest, a pumpkin patch, trick-or-treating, inflatables and a haunted house, TAMIU said. More than 30 food, activity and educational booths are planned for participants of all ages.

Admission is free and open to the public. Halloween Fest also serves as a fundraiser for campus student organizations: tickets bought at the event for food and activities go directly to the participating groups, helping fund conferences and other activities tied to students' academic and personal growth, according to the university.

TAMIU describes the fest as a one-day celebration that draws more than 1,000 community members in a typical year. For more information, the university lists the Office of Student Orientation, Leadership, and Engagement at sole@tamiu.edu or (956) 326-2280.

Sources:

  • Texas A&M International University, "TAMIU Halloween Fest Set for Thursday, Oct. 29," Oct. 8, 2026
  • KGNS, "TAMIU to host family-friendly Halloween fest," Oct. 27, 2026
